```yaml
name: Update pnpm-lock.yaml for Dependabot PRs

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'admin/package.json'
      - 'webapp/package.json'
      - 'packages/*/package.json'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-lockfile:
    if: github.actor == 'dependabot[bot]' && github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'dependabot[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Update pnpm-lock.yaml
        run: |
          pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile
          git config user.name 'dependabot[bot]'
          git config user.email 'dependabot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add pnpm-lock.yaml
          if git diff --cached --stat; then
            git commit -m "chore: update pnpm-lock.yaml"
            git push origin HEAD:${{ github.head_ref }}
          fi

      - name: Add comment to PR
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "Failed to update pnpm-lock.yaml. Please run \`pnpm install\` manually." | gh pr comment ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --body-file -
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
